[quote=british_calradia;60854580][b][u]NBE offers deal with Alaqar[/u][/b]
After another nation on Erene has recognised the Empire's claim to Empire Island as rightfully there's, the New Balion Emperor has reached out directly to the Government of Alaaqr for a message of thanks for the serious and proper action taken towards Gae... Daesunian forces and trade within their nation and offers to them a trade and alliance deal that will help both of our nations. In case of war breaking out, the NBE will send over the foreign secretary, Sir Geoffrey Thatcher to Alaqar's capital to discuss urgent matters regarding both of our nations and the looming Daesunian threat.

[b][u]Close to war with Daesun?[/u][/b]
After the negative response by Daesun, shockwaves have been sent throughout the Empire's economy, news and military sections with looming threats of war occurring. It has also spread towards the general Eastern Argos area as well as nearby traderoutes, many of which stop by Port Augustus on Empire Island during their trips. Naval ships of the Emperor's navy are preparing for war conditions with orders from the war ministry being placed for more warships and aircraft to be produced on both the mainland and Empire Island and the Naval reserves starting to be called up.

Governor of Empire Island, Commodore George Bain has started compiling a list of potential conscripts from the healthy and non-essential males between 18 and 30 list of residents on Empire Island, to potentially be drafted to fight against Daesunian invasion. This means out of a total population of 5 million on the island, with 2.4 million men, it gives a maximum number of potential conscripts to be around 600k with looser restrictions allowing for 1 million to be called up. Military bases on Empire Island from all branches are being called up and put into stanby mode meaning that around 270k soldiers from both reserves, main military and local militia are currently prepared to fight against any threat.

One last call for peace and diplomacy against Daesunian aggression is made before a severe crisis of oil and human suffering ripples around the world.[/quote]
[b]Deployment of the Liberty Carrier Strike Group (LCSG)[/b]

[pre]After Balion's failure to cooperate with Daesunite diplomatic efforts and its blatant mobilization of forces on Empire Island, Daesun pre-emptively declares a status of hostility with the New Balion Empire. Citing its repetitve attempts to form diplomatic channels with the Empire and Balion's uncooperative manner of outright ignoring the Thawne Doctrine. To re-affirm the points of the Thawne Doctrine, and smite colonialism in its tracks, the PSDF will take a more heavy handed stance on the Empire Island crisis.[/pre] 

[i]The PSDF announced the deployment of the Liberty Strike Group (LCSG) to striking range of Empire Island. The group includes 1 Nimitz‑class carrier, 6 Sejong‑class destroyers, 3 Ticonderoga‑class cruisers, 4 Virginia‑class SSNs, 2 Dosan Ahn Changho‑class SSGNs, 1 America‑class LHA, 2 Dokdo‑class LHDs, 8 P‑8s, and 6 E‑2Ds. Carrier‑based F‑35Cs and EA‑18Gs are attached as part of the air wing.[/i]
